create_VideoRetrievalDataset: create a VideoRetrievalDataset from a CSV file with video IDs and sentence annotations
use_VideoRetrievalDataset_getitem: use VideoRetrievalDataset getitem to retrieve preprocessed video frames and associated sentences by index
load_video_frames_decord: load video frames from an MP4 file using decord with uniform frame sampling
fallback_cv2_video_capture: fallback to OpenCV VideoCapture for loading video frames when decord fails
configure_multi_sentence_retrieval: configure VideoRetrievalDataset to split multiple sentences separated by the at symbol delimiter
